description: This file defines a class `ConnectionIdPatternValidator` which extends `AbstractPatternValidator`. The class provides validation logic for connection ID strings against a specific pattern `ConnectionId.ID_PATTERN`. It includes a static factory method `getInstance` to create new instances with a given identifier string, presumably for runtime validation purposes.

classes.name: ConnectionIdPatternValidator
classes.description: A validator class for checking the validity of connection ID strings against a predefined pattern. It is immutable and provides a static factory method for instantiation.
